# Module M1 · Designing

## 1. Learning objectives

- Use the sqlite3 shell (.schema, .read) and keep the schema in a re-runnable schema.sql
- Normalize a messy table into entity tables and describe relationships with ER cardinalities
- Write CREATE TABLE with suitable type affinities, PRIMARY/FOREIGN KEYs and NOT NULL / UNIQUE / DEFAULT / CHECK
- Explain storage classes vs type affinities (including the fares-as-integer argument)
- Evolve a schema with ALTER TABLE (RENAME TO, ADD/RENAME/DROP COLUMN)

## 6. Common mistakes

- **C1.1**: ending dot-commands with `;`; editing only in the prompt
- **C1.2**: storing the same fact in many rows; mixing entities in one table
- **C1.3**: putting a list of ids in one column instead of a junction table
- **C1.4**: trailing comma after the last item; `DROP` instead of `ALTER`
- **C1.5**: believing SQLite types are strict; storing money as REAL; untyped column = BLOB affinity (not NUMERIC, see errata #1)
- **C1.6**: composite PK that forbids legitimate repeats (repeat visits); assuming FKs are enforced without `PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON`
- **C1.7**: redundant constraints on PKs; FK columns DO accept NULL (errata #3)
- **C1.8**: trying to change a column's type/constraints in SQLite (not supported, rebuild instead)
